text:
tom_devrel: Heads-up: running a 2-day interop sprint focused on LangChain/LlamaIndex runners + gateway adapters for Marketplace packaging and HW validation. Want to lock scope and owners.

rachel_pm: I'm happy to own Marketplace artifact requirements and the announcement gating steps. Will need sample thumbnails, one-liners, and a privacy blurb from partners.

nina_partners: I'll line up ISVs and hardware vendors. Quick clarity: do we want connectors published to cloud marketplaces first or a parallel on-prem bundle?

devon_eng: Parallel. Marketplace images should pass the smoke suite; on-prem bundles need additional driver validation and a simple install.sh.

tom_devrel: Sprint scope (minimal): 1) LangChain runner basic generate + tool call, 2) LlamaIndex retrieval end-to-end using our embed API, 3) gateway adapter auth + header passthrough, 4) HW image driver check. Keep tests deterministic.\

pavel_sre: Infra ask: need ephemeral validation nodes with GPU matrix (v100/a10/g4dn) and a small control plane for tracing. Also want a single dashboard link for partners.

rachel_pm: For gating let's require: security review completed, telemetry opt-in documented, marketing asset checklist, partner legal sign-off. I'll create a template doc.

devon_eng: For the runner tests, I'll add a canonical prompt set and function-calling example. Example function test payload:

```json
{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Get me today's top KPI"}],"functions":[{"name":"get_kpi","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"metric":{"type":"string"}}}}]}
```

devon_eng: The shim should return a function call object within 3s on small models. If not, mark as flaky.

nina_partners: On invitations: I'll ask partners to indicate which HW images they can test and whether they need an NDA. Also request a short compatibility statement (e.g., supported CUDA version).

ops-bot: ops-bot: NOTE: quota alert on gpu-pool-2 last week. Recommend running HW validators in staggered windows.

pavel_sre: Noted. We'll schedule GPU validation slots in 30m blocks. Also adding a validation script to check driver/cuDNN versions. Example check we plan to run:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available(), torch.cuda.get_device_name(0))"
/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc --version
```

rachel_pm: Marketing ask: can we get 1-2 short customer-facing sentences from each ISV describing the integration benefit? Keep it <140 chars.

nina_partners: I'll collect those. Also collecting logos in SVG + PNG. Legal needs logos 48h before announcement.

devon_eng: On the LangChain/LlamaIndex side, we need to validate retrieval chains that use our embeddings with windowed chunking. I'll add a test that indexes a 3-doc set and verifies retrieved doc ids for two queries.

pavel_sre: Please provide the test data set (3 docs + 2 queries) and expected doc ids so validation is deterministic.

devon_eng: Will commit test vectors to the harness repo by EOD. Example retrieval vector: docs = ["Deploy notes A","Release checklist B","Performance writeup C"] queries = ["how to deploy","performance tips"].

ops-bot: ops-bot: REMINDER: maintenance window 1714557000-1714557300. Schedule validations outside this window.

tom_devrel: Good catch. Let's do validations before 1714556900 and after 1714557400. 

rachel_pm: Timeline: PRD + asset list by Thu, harness + tests by Fri EOD, partner dry-run next Wed. Is that workable?

nina_partners: Yes. I'll send invites today and ask partners to RSVP with track (marketplace / on-prem) and HW selection.

devon_eng: Two integration notes: 1) gateway adapters must preserve X-Request-ID for tracing; 2) function-calling responses should include deterministic JSON schema. I'll add checks.

pavel_sre: Also ensure test runs include a brief flamegraph capture when latency > 250ms. We'll store traces for 48h.

rachel_pm: Announcement checklist draft: partner approval, logos, one-liners, legal signoff, marketing schedule slot, press embargo dates. I'll post the checklist link in this thread when ready.

nina_partners: One more: HW partners asked whether Marketplace customers get auto-updates. We should clarify update policy in the PRD.

tom_devrel: We'll specify versioning policy: Marketplace images get patch updates; major changes require partner opt-in. On-prem bundles are frozen per release and require a manual upgrade.

devon_eng: I'm starting the harness PR now. Will include run scripts and a small readme for partners to run locally against our sandbox endpoints. Example local run:

```bash
API=https://sandbox.redwood.internal TOKEN=PARTNER_TEST ./run-smoke.sh --profile langchain-runner
```

rachel_pm: Thanks. Let's reconvene Thurs 11am PT for a quick asset and RSVP readout. If blockers pop up, ping here.

nina_partners: Will do. Seeding invites after this thread.

pavel_sre: I'll provision the GPU nodes and post creds to vault once the harness PR lands.

tom_devrel: Thanks team. Small ask: please flag any partner that requires an NDA or extra legal review. We'll triage those first. :white_check_mark:
